lines: F
Excuse me, is this seat taken?
不好意思，这个座位有人吗？
ex: 问座位有没有人，“No, go ahead”表示没人、请坐。第二项把 taken 误解成“拿走”，第三项答非所问。

lines: M
Sorry I'm late. The bus didn't come.
抱歉我迟到了，公交车一直没来。
ex: 对方道歉，应回答“没关系”。第二项重复 bus 一词，第三项把自己当成迟到的人，不合情境。

lines: F
Would you like some more tea?
要再来点茶吗？
c: Yes, I like tea very much.
ex: Would you like…? 是提供东西，回答“要/不要”。第二项把 would like 误听成 like（喜欢），第三项答非所问。

lines: M
How long does it take to get to the station from here?
从这里到车站要多长时间？
ex: How long does it take 问花费的时间。第二项只抓住 long，第三项是回答 how long have you… 的说法。

lines: F
I can't believe I left my umbrella on the train again.
真不敢相信，我又把伞忘在地铁上了。
c: Yes, it's going to rain again.
Good idea. Let's take the train.
Oh no. Maybe you can call the lost and found.
cz: 哎呀，也许你可以给失物招领处打个电话。
ex: 对方抱怨又丢了伞，合适的回应是表示同情并给出建议。第二、三项只是重复了 again、train 等词。

lines: M
Do you mind if I open the window?
你介意我开窗吗？
c: Not at all. It's a bit stuffy in here.
No, I don't have the key.
cz: 一点也不介意，这里有点闷。
ex: Do you mind…? 回答 Yes 表示“介意”，所以同意要说 Not at all。第二项是常见的语气误解，第三项答非所问。

lines: F
You look exhausted. Didn't you get any sleep last night?
你看起来累坏了，昨晚没睡觉吗？
c: Hardly. I was up finishing my paper.
I'll get some at the supermarket.
cz: 是的，我看起来很好，谢谢。
几乎没睡，我熬夜写论文了。
ex: Hardly 表示几乎没睡，并说明原因。第二项与 exhausted 矛盾，第三项把 get some 误解成“买东西”。

lines: M
Shall we grab a bite after class?
下课后一起去吃点东西吧？
c: No, I haven't signed up for that class.
ex: grab a bite 是“随便吃点东西”的口语说法，接受邀请说 Sure。后两项都只围绕 class 回答。

lines: F
I was wondering if you could cover my shift on Saturday.
不知道你周六能不能替我顶一下班。
c: I'd love to help, but I've got a family thing that day.
Sure, I'll buy a new cover for it.
Yes, I was wondering about that too.
cz: 我很想帮你，可那天我家里有事。
好的，我给它买个新套子。
ex: cover one's shift 意为“替人值班”，委婉拒绝并说明理由最自然。第二项把 cover 理解成“套子”，第三项机械重复 wondering。

lines: M
If I'd known the traffic would be this bad, I'd have taken the subway.
早知道堵成这样，我就坐地铁了。
c: Good thing you took the subway, then.
Tell me about it. We'll be lucky to make it by noon.
Yes, the traffic is never bad here.
cz: 可不是嘛，中午前能到就算走运了。
ex: 虚拟语气说明他实际上没坐地铁、正堵在路上，Tell me about it 表示深有同感。第二项误解了虚拟语气，第三项与事实矛盾。

lines: F
You're not seriously thinking of quitting, are you?
你不会真的在考虑辞职吧？
c: Don't worry, I'll think of a good one.
Actually, I've given it a lot of thought.
cz: 别担心，我会想个好点子的。
其实我已经认真考虑很久了。
ex: 对方惊讶地确认是否要辞职，回答“其实已经认真考虑过了”表示确有此意。第二项误解了 thinking of，第三项把 quit 用在戒烟上。

lines: M
The report's due tomorrow, and I haven't even started on the conclusion.
报告明天就要交了，我连结论都还没开始写。
c: Want me to look over what you've got so far?
Great, so you've finished it already.
cz: 要我帮你看看你目前写的部分吗？
太好了，那你已经写完了。
ex: 对方着急报告没写完，主动提出帮忙最自然。第二项与“还没开始写结论”矛盾，第三项把 conclusion 当成已有的结果。

intro: Listen to the conversation. What will the woman buy?
lines: M
Are you going to the supermarket? Can you get some things for the party tonight?
你要去超市吗？能帮我买点今晚聚会用的东西吗？
F
Sure. What do you need?
好啊，要什么？
M
We need some juice and paper cups.
我们需要果汁和纸杯。
F
Paper cups? I think we still have some in the kitchen.
纸杯？我记得厨房里还有一些。
M
Oh, you're right. Then just juice. Oh, and a cake, too.
哦，对。那就只买果汁吧。啊，还有一个蛋糕。
F
Didn't your sister say she'd bring a cake?
你姐姐不是说她会带蛋糕来吗？
M
Yes, she did. I forgot. OK, juice and some ice, then.
对，她说过，我忘了。那就买果汁和冰块吧。
F
Got it. Juice and ice.
知道了，果汁和冰块。
q: What will the woman buy?
ex: 最后男的说 juice and some ice。纸杯厨房里还有，蛋糕姐姐会带来，所以都不用买。

intro: Listen to the conversation between a mother and her son. What will the boy do first?
lines: F
Tom, are you going out to play soccer?
汤姆，你要出去踢足球吗？
M
Yes, Mom. The game starts at four.
是的，妈妈。比赛四点开始。
F
Did you finish your homework?
作业写完了吗？
M
Not yet. I'll do it after the game.
还没有，比赛完再写。
F
Hmm. Then at least clean your room before you go. It's a mess.
嗯……那出门前至少把房间收拾一下，乱成一团了。
M
But I'll be late!
可是我会迟到的！
F
It's only two thirty. You have plenty of time.
现在才两点半，你时间多着呢。
M
OK, OK. I'll do it now.
好吧好吧，我现在就收拾。
q: What will the boy do first?
ex: 妈妈让他出门前先收拾房间，他回答 I'll do it now。作业要等比赛后再写，踢球在收拾房间之后。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a library. What will the woman do next?
lines: F
Hi, I'd like to borrow these three books.
你好，我想借这三本书。
M
Sure. Can I see your library card?
好的，请出示一下借书证。
F
Oh, I left it at home. Can I use my student ID instead?
啊，我把它忘在家里了。可以用学生证代替吗？
M
Sorry, you need a library card. But you can make a new one at the front desk. It only takes five minutes.
抱歉，必须用借书证。不过你可以在服务台办一张新的，只要五分钟。
F
Oh, OK. Where's the front desk?
哦，好的。服务台在哪里？
M
Right by the main entrance.
就在正门旁边。
F
Thanks. I'll go there now.
谢谢，我现在就过去。
q: What will the woman do next?
c: Go home to get her library card
Get a new library card at the front desk
ex: 管理员说可以在服务台办新卡，女的说 I'll go there now。学生证不能用，她也没有回家拿卡。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a café. What will the man have?
lines: F
Hi, what can I get you?
你好，要点什么？
M
Can I have a large coffee, please?
请给我一杯大杯咖啡。
F
Sorry, our coffee machine is broken today. We have tea or hot chocolate.
抱歉，今天咖啡机坏了。我们有茶和热巧克力。
M
Oh, OK. Then a hot chocolate.
哦，好吧。那就热巧克力。
F
Large or small?
大杯还是小杯？
M
Hmm, small, please. And a sandwich.
嗯，小杯吧。再要一个三明治。
F
Sorry, we just sold the last sandwich. We have muffins.
抱歉，最后一个三明治刚卖完了。我们有松饼。
M
A muffin is fine.
松饼也行。
q: What will the man have?
c: A large coffee and a sandwich
A small hot chocolate and a muffin
A large hot chocolate and a muffin
A small tea and a sandwich
ex: 咖啡机坏了，他改点小杯热巧克力；三明治卖完了，改要松饼。

intro: Listen to the conversation between a student and her professor. What will the woman do first?
lines: F
Professor Lee, do you have a minute? It's about my term paper.
李教授，您有空吗？是关于我的学期论文的事。
M
Sure, Lisa. What's up?
当然，丽莎。什么事？
F
I was planning to write about online shopping, but I'm finding it hard to narrow down.
我打算写网购，但发现很难缩小范围。
M
That's a very broad topic. Why not focus on one group, say, college students?
这个题目太宽泛了。为什么不只关注一个群体，比如大学生呢？
F
That's a good idea. Should I start with a survey, then?
好主意。那我应该先做问卷调查吗？
M
Not yet. First, read a few articles to see what's already been done. Then design your survey.
先别急。先读几篇文章，看看别人已经做过哪些研究，然后再设计问卷。
F
OK. Could you recommend some?
好的，您能推荐几篇吗？
M
Check the reading list I posted online. Start with the two articles marked with a star.
看看我发在网上的阅读书目，先读标了星号的那两篇。
F
Great, I'll do that tonight.
太好了，我今晚就读。
q: What will the woman do first?
c: Design a survey for college students
Read the articles marked on the reading list
Change her topic to campus life
cz: 读阅读书目中标星的文章
ex: 教授说 First, read a few articles，并让她先读标星号的两篇。问卷要在读完文章之后再设计。

intro: Listen to the conversation. What will the man do next?
lines: M
I've found a hotel near the beach for our trip. It's a bit pricey, though.
我给我们的旅行找到一家海边的酒店，不过有点贵。
F
How about the one we stayed at last year?
去年我们住的那家怎么样？
M
I already checked. It's fully booked that weekend.
我查过了，那个周末订满了。
F
That's a shame. What about going the following weekend instead?
真可惜。那改成下一个周末去呢？
M
I can't. I've got a conference then.
不行，那时我有个会议。
F
Well, let's just book the beach one. We only do this once a year.
那就订海边那家吧，反正一年就这一次。
M
True. But let me see if they offer a discount for booking early. I'll call them now.
也是。不过我先问问提前预订有没有折扣，我现在就打电话。
F
Good idea. I'll ask my mom if she can feed the cat while we're away.
好主意。我去问问我妈，我们不在时她能不能帮忙喂猫。
q: What will the man do next?
c: Book the hotel they stayed at last year
Move the trip to the following weekend
Ask the woman's mother to feed the cat
Call the beach hotel about a discount
cz: 打电话问海边酒店有没有折扣
ex: 男的说 I'll call them now，询问提前预订的折扣。去年的酒店已订满，下周末他要开会，问妈妈喂猫的是女的。

intro: Listen to the conversation in an office. What will the woman do next?
lines: M
Jenny, the meeting with the clients has been moved up to ten.
珍妮，和客户的会议提前到十点了。
F
Ten? I haven't printed the handouts yet!
十点？我还没打印讲义呢！
M
Don't panic. The printer on our floor is out of order, but you can use the one downstairs.
别慌。我们这层的打印机坏了，不过你可以用楼下那台。
F
OK. Should I make twenty copies?
好的。要印二十份吗？
M
Only twelve clients are coming, so fifteen should be enough.
只来十二位客户，十五份就够了。
F
Got it. What about the projector?
明白了。那投影仪呢？
M
I'll take care of that. Just get the copies done.
我来弄。你只管把材料印好。
F
Thanks. I'm on my way.
谢谢，我这就去。
q: What will the woman do next?
c: Fix the printer on her floor
Make twenty copies of the handouts
ex: 本层打印机坏了，要用楼下的；份数从二十份改为十五份。投影仪由男的负责。

intro: Listen to the conversation. What will the woman do first?
lines: F
So, the landlord finally got back to me about the apartment.
房东终于回复我公寓的事了。
M
And? Did they accept your offer?
然后呢？他接受你的出价了吗？
F
Sort of. He'll lower the rent, but only if I sign a two-year lease.
算是吧。他愿意降房租，但前提是我签两年的租约。
M
Two years is a long commitment, especially with your job situation up in the air.
两年可不短，何况你的工作还没定下来。
F
That's what worries me. If I get the transfer to Chicago, I'd be stuck paying rent here.
我担心的就是这个。如果我被调到芝加哥，还得一直在这边付房租。
M
Can't you ask whether there's a clause that lets you break the lease if you relocate for work?
你不能问问有没有因工作调动可以提前解约的条款吗？
F
I could, but I'd rather know about the transfer first. My manager said she'd decide by Friday.
可以问，但我更想先知道调动的结果。经理说她周五前会决定。
M
Then hold off on signing. Just tell the landlord you need until Monday.
那就先别签。跟房东说你需要等到周一。
F
You're right. I'll email him right now before he offers it to someone else.
你说得对。我现在就给他发邮件，免得他租给别人。
q: What will the woman do first?
c: Ask her manager about the transfer
Ask the landlord to wait until Monday
Ask for a clause about breaking the lease
cz: 要求加入提前解约的条款
ex: 男的建议先别签约、告诉房东需要等到周一，女的说马上给房东发邮件。调动结果要等经理周五决定，解约条款她并不打算先问。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two conference organizers. What will the man do next?
lines: M
We've got a problem with the keynote speaker. Her flight's been cancelled because of the storm.
主讲嘉宾出问题了。因为暴风雨，她的航班取消了。
F
Oh no. The conference starts tomorrow morning. Is there any chance she can get another flight?
糟了，会议明天上午就开始了。她有可能改签别的航班吗？
M
The earliest one lands at noon, so she'd miss her slot.
最早的一班中午才落地，她会错过自己的时段。
F
Could we swap her talk with the afternoon panel?
能把她的演讲和下午的小组讨论对调吗？
M
I thought of that, but two of the panelists are leaving right after lunch.
我想过，但有两位讨论嘉宾午饭后就要走。
F
What about having her give the talk by video link?
那让她通过视频连线演讲呢？
M
That could work. She mentioned she'd be fine with that. I'd just need to make sure the hall's equipment can handle it.
这个可行，她说过她没问题。我只需要确认会场的设备能不能支持。
F
Then check with the technical team first, before we tell anyone else.
那在通知其他人之前，先去和技术团队确认。
M
Right. I'll head over to the hall and talk to them now.
好，我现在就去会场找他们谈。
q: What will the man do next?
c: Book the speaker a later flight
Swap the keynote with the afternoon panel
Talk to the technical team about the equipment
Announce the change to the participants
cz: 给嘉宾订晚一点的航班
把主旨演讲和下午的讨论对调
ex: 两人决定改为视频演讲，男的要先去会场和技术团队确认设备。改签会错过时段，对调因嘉宾要提前离开不可行，通知其他人要等确认之后。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a visa office. What will the woman do first?
lines: F
Hi, I'm here to apply for a student visa. I have an appointment at two.
你好，我来申请学生签证，约的是两点。
M
Let me see. Do you have your passport, your acceptance letter, and the application form?
我看看。你带护照、录取通知书和申请表了吗？
F
Yes, they're all here. And I printed out my bank statements, too.
都带了。我还打印了银行流水。
M
Thanks. Hmm, these statements only cover the last month. We need at least three months.
谢谢。嗯，这些流水只有最近一个月的，我们至少需要三个月的。
F
Oh, I didn't realize. Can I just show them on my phone?
哦，我不知道。我可以在手机上给您看吗？
M
I'm afraid we need printed copies, stamped by the bank.
恐怕我们需要银行盖章的纸质版。
F
The bank's just across the street. Could I go there and come back today?
银行就在街对面。我能去一趟今天再回来吗？
M
Sure, we're open until five. And your photo is over six months old, so you'll need a new one. There's a photo booth in the lobby downstairs.
可以，我们开到五点。另外你的照片已经超过六个月了，需要新照片。楼下大厅有自助拍照机。
F
The lobby, great. I'll do that first, then head to the bank.
在大厅啊，太好了。我先拍照，再去银行。
q: What will the woman do first?
c: Show the statements on her phone
ex: 女的最后说 I'll do that first, then head to the bank，即先在楼下拍照，再去银行。手机出示不被接受，申请表已经带来了。

intro: Listen to the conversation at school. Why was the woman late for school?
lines: M
Hi, Amy. You're late today. Did you oversleep?
嗨，艾米，你今天迟到了。睡过头了吗？
F
No, I got up early.
没有，我起得很早。
M
Was the bus late again?
又是公交车晚点了？
F
No, I rode my bike today. But on the way, it got a flat tire.
不是，我今天骑自行车来的，可路上车胎瘪了。
M
Oh no. Did you take it to the bike shop?
哎呀，你把车送去车铺了吗？
F
No, it was closed. So I had to push it all the way here.
没有，车铺关门了，所以我只好一路推着车过来。
q: Why was the woman late for school?
c: She took her bike to the shop.
Her bike had a flat tire.
ex: 女的说路上车胎瘪了，只好推车过来。她没睡过头，也没坐公交，车铺关门了没有修车。

intro: Listen to the conversation. What time will they meet?
lines: F
Do you want to see the new movie on Saturday?
周六想去看那部新电影吗？
M
Sure. What time does it start?
好啊，几点开始？
F
There are shows at two and five.
两点和五点各有一场。
M
I have a piano lesson until three.
我三点前有钢琴课。
F
Then let's go to the five o'clock show. Let's meet at the station at four thirty.
那我们看五点那场吧。四点半在车站见。
M
Hmm, can we meet at four? I want to get some popcorn before the movie.
嗯，能四点见吗？我想看电影前买点爆米花。
F
OK, four it is.
好，那就四点。
q: What time will they meet?
ex: 女的先提议四点半，男的想买爆米花改成四点，女的同意了。五点是电影开场时间，三点是钢琴课结束时间。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a doctor's office. What does the doctor think is causing the man's headache?
lines: F
Good morning. What seems to be the problem?
早上好，哪里不舒服？
M
I have a bad headache, doctor.
医生，我头疼得厉害。
F
Do you have a fever or a sore throat?
发烧或嗓子疼吗？
M
No fever, and my throat is fine.
没发烧，嗓子也没事。
F
How much are you sleeping?
你睡多久？
M
Not much. I've been studying for exams until two every night.
睡得不多。我每晚都复习考试到两点。
F
I think that's the reason. Try to go to bed before midnight. And drink plenty of water, too.
我想原因就在这里。尽量十二点前睡觉，也要多喝水。
q: What does the doctor think is causing the man's headache?
c: He studies in a cold room.
ex: 男的每晚学习到两点，医生说 I think that's the reason，即睡眠不足。他没有发烧，嗓子也没问题。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a student housing office. Why does the woman want to change rooms?
lines: F
Excuse me, I'd like to ask about changing my dorm room.
打扰一下，我想咨询换宿舍的事。
M
Is something wrong with your roommate?
是跟室友有什么问题吗？
F
No, she's really nice. And the room itself is fine, though it's a bit small.
不是，她人很好。房间本身也还行，虽然有点小。
M
Then what's the problem?
那是什么问题呢？
F
It's right next to the elevator. People go up and down all night, and I can't sleep.
房间就在电梯旁边，整晚都有人上上下下，我睡不着。
M
I see. There's a room open on the fourth floor, at the end of the hall. It's quieter, but it's farther from the bathroom.
明白了。四楼走廊尽头有一间空房，比较安静，不过离卫生间远一些。
F
That's no problem at all.
那完全没问题。
q: Why does the woman want to change rooms?
c: She doesn't get along with her roommate.
Her room is far from the bathroom.
Her room is noisy at night.
ex: 女的说房间在电梯旁，整晚有人来往睡不着。室友很好，房间小她并不在意，离卫生间远说的是新房间。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two friends. What does the man like most about his new job?
lines: F
So how's the new job going?
新工作怎么样？
M
Pretty well. The pay's not much better than before, to be honest.
挺好的。说实话，工资没比以前高多少。
F
Oh? But you seem a lot happier.
是吗？可你看起来开心多了。
M
I am. The office is close to home, so I can walk to work. But what I really love is my team. Everyone helps each other out.
确实。办公室离家近，我可以走路上班。不过我最喜欢的是我的团队，大家都互相帮忙。
F
That makes a big difference.
那差别可大了。
M
It does. At my last job, I hardly talked to anyone all day.
是啊。上一份工作我一整天几乎不跟人说话。
q: What does the man like most about his new job?
c: Being able to walk to work
ex: 男的说 what I really love is my team，最喜欢的是同事互相帮助。工资没高多少，走路上班只是优点之一。

intro: Listen to the phone call to a restaurant. Why is the man calling?
lines: F
Good evening, Bella Cucina. How can I help you?
晚上好，这里是贝拉厨房。有什么可以帮您？
M
Hi, I have a reservation for tonight at seven, under the name Wilson.
你好，我订了今晚七点的位子，名字是威尔逊。
F
Yes, Mr. Wilson, a table for four.
是的，威尔逊先生，四人桌。
M
Actually, that's why I'm calling. Two more friends are joining us. Is it possible to make it six?
其实我就是为这个打电话的。又有两个朋友要来，能改成六个人吗？
F
Let me check. Hmm, we don't have a table for six at seven, but there's one at eight.
我查一下。嗯，七点没有六人桌，八点有一张。
M
Eight is a bit late, but OK. We'll take it.
八点有点晚，不过行，就订这个吧。
F
Great. A table for six at eight o'clock.
好的，八点，六人桌。
q: Why is the man calling?
c: To change his reservation to an earlier time
To add more people to his reservation
To book a table for tomorrow
ex: 男的说又有两个朋友要来，想改成六人。时间从七点改到八点是结果，而且是改晚不是改早。

intro: Listen to the announcement at a museum. Which part of the museum is closed today?
lines: F
Good morning, and welcome to the City Science Museum.
早上好，欢迎来到市科学博物馆。
F
We'd like to let you know that the space exhibition on the second floor is closed today for repairs. It will reopen tomorrow.
我们通知各位，二楼的太空展厅今天因维修关闭，明天重新开放。
F
However, the dinosaur hall and the new robot exhibition on the third floor are open as usual.
不过，恐龙馆和三楼新的机器人展照常开放。
F
The robot show will begin at eleven, and again at two in the afternoon.
机器人表演在十一点开始，下午两点还有一场。
F
Please also note that the café on the first floor will close early today, at three.
另外请注意，一楼咖啡厅今天提前到三点关门。
F
Thank you, and enjoy your visit.
谢谢，祝您参观愉快。
q: Which part of the museum is closed today?
c: The café on the first floor
ex: 广播说二楼太空展厅今天维修关闭。恐龙馆和机器人展照常开放，咖啡厅只是提前到三点关门。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two coworkers. Why did the woman turn down the job offer?
lines: M
I heard you turned down the offer from that consulting firm. I thought it was your dream job.
听说你拒绝了那家咨询公司的录用。我还以为那是你梦寐以求的工作。
F
In a way, it was. The salary was great, and they were even willing to let me work from home twice a week.
某种程度上是。薪水很高，他们甚至同意我每周在家办公两天。
M
So what was the catch? The commute?
那问题出在哪？通勤吗？
F
Not really; it's only forty minutes by train. It was more that, in the final interview, they told me I'd be traveling almost every week.
不是，坐火车才四十分钟。主要是终面时他们告诉我几乎每周都要出差。
M
Ah. With your dad's health the way it is...
啊，你爸爸身体那个样子……
F
Exactly. I need to be around. Maybe in a couple of years things will be different.
没错，我得在家附近。也许过几年情况会不一样。
M
That makes sense. Family comes first.
可以理解，家人最重要。
q: Why did the woman turn down the job offer?
ex: 女的说几乎每周都要出差，而父亲身体不好她需要留在身边。薪水很高，通勤只有四十分钟，公司也允许在家办公。

intro: Listen to the news report. Why is the festival being moved?
lines: M
Officials in the coastal town of Fairhaven announced yesterday that the summer music festival will be moved from the town beach to the city park.
海滨小镇费尔黑文的官员昨天宣布，夏季音乐节将从镇上的海滩移到市公园举办。
M
The festival has drawn visitors from across the region for over thirty years.
三十多年来，这个音乐节吸引了来自整个地区的游客。
M
Many residents assumed the change was due to rising costs, but the mayor explained that the real reason is the beach itself.
许多居民以为改变地点是因为费用上涨，但镇长解释说，真正的原因在于海滩本身。
M
Storms over the past two winters have washed away much of the sand, leaving too little space for the stage and the crowds.
过去两个冬天的风暴冲走了大量沙子，剩下的空间放不下舞台和人群。
M
The town plans to restore the beach, but the work won't be finished until next year.
镇上计划修复海滩，但工程要到明年才能完成。
M
Ticket prices, the mayor added, will remain the same.
镇长还补充说，票价将保持不变。
q: Why is the festival being moved?
c: The cost of holding it has risen.
The town wants to attract more visitors.
Storms have left the beach with too little space.
ex: 镇长说真正的原因是风暴冲走了沙子，海滩放不下舞台和人群。费用上涨只是居民的猜测，票价不变，吸引游客是音乐节过去的情况。

intro: Listen to the conversation about a study. According to the woman, what was the main finding of the study?
lines: F
Did you read that study on remote work that came out last week?
你读了上周发表的那项关于远程办公的研究吗？
M
I skimmed it. Everyone expected productivity to drop, right?
大概翻了翻。大家都以为生产效率会下降，对吧？
F
That's what I thought too, but it actually stayed about the same.
我也是这么想的，但实际上基本没变。
M
So what was the big finding?
那主要发现是什么？
F
The interesting part was about new hires. People who started their jobs remotely were far less likely to ask questions, and many of them left within a year.
有意思的是关于新员工的部分。远程入职的人很少提问，而且很多人一年内就离职了。
M
Huh. I'd have guessed experienced workers would struggle more, since they're used to the office.
嗯？我还以为习惯了办公室的老员工会更难适应。
F
Apparently not. They adapted fine. It's the newcomers who miss out on learning from colleagues.
看来不是。他们适应得很好。错过向同事学习机会的是新人。
q: According to the woman, what was the main finding of the study?
c: Productivity dropped when people worked remotely.
New employees who started remotely struggled more.
Experienced workers found it hard to adapt.
cz: 远程办公使生产效率下降。
远程入职的新员工更吃力。
有经验的员工难以适应。
ex: 女的说研究的有趣之处在于远程入职的新人很少提问、很多人一年内离职。生产效率基本没变，老员工适应良好，远程新人提问反而更少。

intro: A teacher is talking to her students.
lines: F
Good morning, everyone. Next Tuesday, we're going on a school trip to a farm.
大家早上好。下周二我们要去农场进行学校旅行。
F
We'll leave school by bus at eight thirty.
我们八点半坐大巴从学校出发。
F
At the farm, you'll feed the cows and pick strawberries.
在农场，你们会喂奶牛、摘草莓。
F
Please bring your lunch, a water bottle, and a hat, because it may be sunny.
请带上午饭、水壶和帽子，因为可能会很晒。
F
And don't forget to give this letter to your parents and bring it back by Friday.
还有，别忘了把这封信交给家长，周五前交回来。
q: What is the teacher mainly talking about?
c: How to take care of cows
ex: 老师介绍了出发时间、活动内容和要带的东西，主题是学校旅行的安排。喂奶牛、带午饭都只是其中的细节。

intro: A man is talking about his weekends.
lines: M
Every Sunday morning, I go to the park near my house.
每个星期天早上，我都去家附近的公园。
M
But I don't go there to run or play sports. I go there to pick up trash.
但我去那里不是跑步或运动，而是去捡垃圾。
M
About ten people from my neighborhood join me. We bring bags and gloves.
大约有十个邻居和我一起，我们带着袋子和手套。
M
After an hour, the park looks much cleaner.
一个小时后，公园就干净多了。
M
Then we have coffee together and chat. I've made a lot of new friends this way.
然后我们一起喝咖啡聊天。我就这样交了很多新朋友。
q: What is the man mainly talking about?
c: Running in the park on Sundays
Cleaning the park with his neighbors
ex: 男的讲的是每周日和邻居在公园捡垃圾的活动。他明确说不是去跑步，喝咖啡和袋子手套只是细节。

intro: Listen to part of a radio program.
lines: F
Many of us check our phones right before going to sleep. It feels relaxing, but it may be doing more harm than good.
很多人睡前都会看手机。这感觉很放松，但可能弊大于利。
F
The light from the screen tells our brain that it's still daytime, so it becomes harder to fall asleep.
屏幕的光会让大脑以为还是白天，于是更难入睡。
F
On top of that, reading messages or the news keeps our minds active when they should be slowing down.
此外，看消息或新闻会让大脑在该放慢的时候保持活跃。
F
Some people say they only watch funny videos, but even that delays sleep.
有人说自己只看搞笑视频，但那同样会推迟入睡。
F
So try putting your phone in another room an hour before bed. Read a paper book or listen to quiet music instead.
所以试试睡前一小时把手机放到别的房间，改为读纸质书或听轻音乐。
F
You may be surprised at how much better you feel the next morning.
第二天早上你会惊讶于自己感觉好了多少。
q: What is the speaker mainly talking about?
c: Why using a phone before bed is a bad idea
How to choose a good paper book
The benefits of watching funny videos
How to read the news more quickly
cz: 为什么睡前用手机不好
ex: 说话人解释了睡前看手机影响睡眠的原因，并建议睡前一小时远离手机。纸质书、搞笑视频、新闻都只是例子。

intro: A man is speaking to new students at a university.
lines: M
Welcome, everyone. I'd like to tell you about something many first-year students don't know about: the Writing Center.
欢迎大家。我想介绍一个很多新生都不知道的地方：写作中心。
M
It's on the second floor of the library, and it's completely free.
它在图书馆二楼，完全免费。
M
You can bring any kind of writing: an essay, a lab report, even a job application.
你可以带任何文稿来：论文、实验报告，甚至求职申请。
M
The tutors won't write it for you, but they'll help you organize your ideas and fix common mistakes.
辅导老师不会替你写，但会帮你理清思路、改正常见错误。
M
A lot of students only come the night before a deadline. Try to visit earlier, when you still have time to make real changes.
很多学生截止前一晚才来。尽量早点来，那时你还有时间真正修改。
M
You can make an appointment on the university website.
可以在学校网站上预约。
q: What is the speaker mainly talking about?
c: How to apply for a job on campus
The opening hours of the library
A service that helps students with their writing
How to write a good lab report
ex: 整段话都在介绍写作中心能为学生提供的帮助和使用方法。图书馆、实验报告、求职申请只是提到的细节。

intro: Listen to a news report.
lines: F
Starting next month, the city of Riverside will launch a new bike-sharing program.
从下个月起，河滨市将推出新的共享单车项目。
F
Five hundred bikes will be placed at sixty stations downtown and near major bus stops.
五百辆自行车将投放到市中心和主要公交站附近的六十个站点。
F
Users can rent a bike with a smartphone app, and the first thirty minutes of each ride will be free.
用户可以用手机应用租车，每次骑行前三十分钟免费。
F
City officials hope the program will reduce traffic in the city center and encourage people to exercise.
市政官员希望这个项目能减少市中心的交通拥堵，并鼓励人们锻炼身体。
F
If it proves popular, it will be expanded to other parts of the city next year.
如果反响好，明年将扩展到城市其他地区。
q: What is the news report mainly about?
c: A new smartphone app for buses
A new bike-sharing program in the city
cz: 公交站附近的交通问题
城市新的共享单车项目
面向市政员工的健身项目
ex: 新闻介绍了共享单车项目的规模、使用方法和目的。公交站、手机应用、锻炼都是相关细节，不是主题。

intro: Listen to part of a lecture.
lines: M
Most of us assume that having more choices makes us happier. After all, more options mean a better chance of finding exactly what we want.
大多数人认为选择越多越幸福。毕竟选项越多，越有可能找到正合心意的东西。
M
But psychologists have found that beyond a certain point, extra choices can actually work against us.
但心理学家发现，超过一定程度后，多出来的选择反而对我们不利。
M
When faced with dozens of similar products, shoppers often take longer to decide, and some walk away without buying anything at all.
面对几十种相似的商品，顾客往往要花更长时间做决定，有些人干脆什么都不买就走了。
M
Even those who do choose tend to feel less satisfied, because they keep wondering whether one of the other options would have been better.
即使做出了选择的人也往往不太满意，因为他们总在想别的选项会不会更好。
M
Some businesses have responded by deliberately cutting the number of products they offer, and they've seen sales go up.
一些商家因此有意减少商品种类，结果销量反而上升了。
M
So the next time you feel stuck in front of a long menu, remember: the problem may not be you, but the number of options.
所以下次你对着长长的菜单犹豫不决时，记住：问题可能不在你，而在选项太多。
q: What is the main idea of the talk?
c: Too many choices can make decisions harder and less satisfying.
Businesses should offer more products to increase sales.
Shoppers are happier when they spend longer choosing.
Long menus help people find exactly what they want.
cz: 选择太多会让决定更难、满意度更低。
商家应提供更多商品来提高销量。
顾客花更多时间挑选会更开心。
长菜单帮助人们找到正想要的东西。
ex: 讲座的核心是选择过多反而让人难以决定、满意度下降。减少商品种类才使销量上升，其余选项都与讲座内容相反。

intro: Listen to part of a radio program.
lines: F
When we think about fighting summer heat in cities, we usually think of air conditioning.
说到应对城市夏季高温，我们通常会想到空调。
F
But air conditioners push hot air back outside, and they use huge amounts of electricity.
但空调会把热空气排到室外，而且耗电巨大。
F
A growing number of cities are turning to a much older solution: trees.
越来越多的城市开始转向一个古老得多的办法：种树。
F
Streets lined with trees can be several degrees cooler than bare ones, because leaves provide shade and release moisture into the air.
有行道树的街道比光秃秃的街道能凉快好几度，因为树叶能遮阴并向空气中释放水分。
F
Trees aren't a quick fix, of course. They take years to grow, and they need care and water.
当然，树木不是立竿见影的办法，它们要长好几年，还需要养护和浇水。
F
Still, many urban planners now argue that planting trees is one of the smartest long-term investments a city can make.
尽管如此，许多城市规划者认为，种树是城市最明智的长期投资之一。
q: What is the speaker's main point?
c: Air conditioners should be banned in cities.
Trees need too much water to be worth planting.
Older solutions are always better than new ones.
Planting trees is a valuable long-term way to cool cities.
cz: 城市应该禁止使用空调。
树需要太多水，不值得种。
种树是给城市降温的有价值的长期办法。
ex: 说话人虽然承认树木见效慢、需要养护，但结论是种树是城市降温的明智长期投资。并未主张禁止空调，“老办法”也只是对种树的形容。

intro: Listen to part of a talk.
lines: M
In an age when we can fill every spare minute with our phones, boredom has almost disappeared from daily life.
在这个能用手机填满每一分空闲的时代，无聊几乎从日常生活中消失了。
M
Waiting for a bus or standing in line used to mean simply doing nothing. Now we scroll.
过去等车或排队就意味着什么都不做，现在我们刷手机。
M
That might seem harmless, but researchers who study creativity are beginning to worry.
这看似无害，但研究创造力的学者开始担心了。
M
When our minds have nothing to focus on, they start to wander, and that wandering is often where new ideas come from.
当大脑没有可专注的东西时，就会开始漫游，而新点子往往就来自这种漫游。
M
In several experiments, people who had first done a dull task came up with more creative solutions afterward.
在几项实验中，先做了枯燥任务的人随后想出了更有创意的解决办法。
M
So rather than reaching for your phone the next time you're bored, let your mind drift for a while. It could be time well spent.
所以下次无聊时，别急着拿手机，让思绪飘一会儿吧，这段时间可能很值得。
q: What is the speaker mainly saying about boredom?
c: Phones have made people more bored than before.
It can help people become more creative.
Waiting in line is a waste of time.
Researchers have found ways to end it.
cz: 手机让人比以前更无聊。
它能帮助人们变得更有创造力。
研究者找到了消除它的方法。
ex: 说话人认为无聊时思绪漫游是新想法的来源，实验也表明它能促进创造力。手机其实让无聊几乎消失了，其他选项与内容不符。

lines: M
Is this your pen? I found it under the desk.
这是你的笔吗？我在桌子底下捡到的。
c: No, I don't have a desk.
Yes, I'll look under the desk.
cz: 好的，我去桌子底下找找。
ex: 对方捡到笔问是不是你的，应确认并道谢。“去桌子底下找”和“没有桌子”都只是抓住了 desk 一词，答非所问。

lines: F
What time does the cafeteria close today?
食堂今天几点关门？
cz: 我今天在那儿吃的面条。
ex: What time 问时间，应回答具体钟点。“在那儿吃了面条”答非所问，“在图书馆旁边”回答的是地点。

lines: M
Can you lend me your notes from yesterday's class?
能把昨天上课的笔记借我吗？
c: Yes, I lent them to you yesterday.
ex: 对方请求借笔记，自然回答是“当然，给你”。“昨天借给你了”把 yesterday 用错了地方，“课是九点的”答非所问。

lines: F
How about going for a run together tomorrow morning?
明天早上一起去跑步怎么样？
ex: How about…? 是提议，应表示接受或拒绝。“跑了一个小时”时态不对，“是明天早上”只是重复了对方的话。

lines: M
Whose turn is it to take out the trash?
这次轮到谁倒垃圾？
c: Yes, there's a lot of trash.
ex: Whose turn 问“轮到谁”，应回答人。“在厨房里”回答的是地点，“垃圾很多”用 Yes 回答特殊疑问句，不合语法逻辑。

lines: F
I've lost my student card. What should I do?
我把学生证弄丢了，该怎么办？
c: I've got a student card, too.
You should report it at the service center.
cz: 你应该去服务中心挂失。
ex: 对方问丢了学生证怎么办，应给出建议。“我也有学生证”“那是你的学生证”都只是重复了 student card。

lines: M
The printer in the library is out of paper again.
图书馆的打印机又没纸了。
c: Yes, I read the paper this morning.
Let's tell the front desk, then.
Then I'll print it in the library.
cz: 是啊，我今天早上看了报纸。
那我就在图书馆打印吧。
ex: 打印机没纸，合理反应是去告诉前台。“看了报纸”把 paper 理解成报纸，“在图书馆打印”恰恰是做不到的事。

lines: F
Have you signed up for any clubs yet?
你报名参加什么社团了吗？
c: Yes, I signed my name on the paper.
ex: sign up for 是“报名参加”。“在纸上签名”只抓住了 sign，“社团周五活动”没有回答自己有没有报名。

lines: M
I can't make it to the study group tonight. Could you fill me in later?
今晚的学习小组我去不了，之后能跟我说说讲了什么吗？
c: No problem. I'll text you what we cover.
The study group was great tonight.
Sure, I'll fill in the form for you.
cz: 没问题，我会发消息告诉你我们讲了什么。
ex: fill sb. in 是“告诉某人情况”，应答应事后告知。“帮你填表”把 fill in 当成填写，“今晚很棒”时间上说不通，小组还没开始。

lines: F
These washing machines take forever, don't they?
这些洗衣机洗得也太慢了，是吧？
c: Tell me about it. I've been waiting for an hour.
cz: 可不是嘛，我已经等了一个小时了。
ex: take forever 是抱怨“慢得要命”，Tell me about it 表示深有同感。另两项分别误解了 take forever 和 washing。

lines: M
Would you rather eat in or get takeaway?
你想在店里吃还是打包带走？
ex: Would you rather A or B 是二选一，要选其中一个。用 Yes 回答选择疑问句不对，“已经吃过了”与 eat 相关但答非所问。

lines: F
You might want to double-check the deadline. I heard it was moved up.
你最好再确认一下截止日期，我听说提前了。
c: Really? I'd better check the course website.
Great, so we have more time.
I've checked it twice, so it's moved.
cz: 真的吗？那我得去课程网站看看。
太好了，那我们时间更多了。
我查了两遍，所以它被改了。
ex: move up 指“提前”，合理反应是赶快去确认。“时间更多了”把提前误解成推迟，“查了两遍所以改了”因果颠倒。

lines: M
I'd have gone to the career fair if I hadn't had a lab that afternoon.
要不是那天下午有实验课，我就去招聘会了。
c: So how did you like the fair?
Which lab did you go to after the fair?
Don't worry, there's another one next month.
cz: 那你觉得招聘会怎么样？
招聘会之后你去了哪个实验室？
别担心，下个月还有一场。
ex: 虚拟语气说明他其实没去招聘会，应安慰他。问“招聘会怎么样”“招聘会之后去哪个实验室”都误以为他去了。

lines: F
There's no way I'm finishing this book by Monday.
周一之前我绝对读不完这本书。
c: Why don't you ask the professor for an extension?
I finished it by Monday, too.
Great, then you can lend it to me on Monday.
cz: 你何不去请教授延期呢？
太好了，那你周一就能借给我了。
ex: There's no way… 表示“绝不可能”，应给出建议。另两项都误以为她能读完。

lines: M
Hardly anyone showed up to the seminar this morning.
今天上午的研讨会几乎没人来。
c: Maybe it was because of the rainstorm.
I'll show you the way to the seminar.
cz: 我带你去研讨会的地方。
ex: hardly anyone 是“几乎没有人”，推测原因最自然。“人特别多”意思相反，“带你去”只是抓住了 show。

lines: F
I could have sworn I'd locked my bike, but it's gone.
我敢发誓我锁了车，可车不见了。
c: Good thing you locked it, then.
Have you reported it to campus security?
Where did you buy the lock?
ex: 车被偷了，应建议报告保安。“幸好锁了”与车不见的事实矛盾，“锁在哪儿买的”答非所问。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a campus store. What will the man buy?
lines: M
Hi, I need a notebook and a pen for my English class.
你好，我英语课要用一个笔记本和一支笔。
F
The notebooks are over there. We have small ones and large ones.
笔记本在那边，有小的也有大的。
M
I'll take a large one. And the pens?
我要一个大的。那笔呢？
F
Sorry, we sold out of blue pens this morning. We only have black ones.
抱歉，蓝色的笔今天上午卖完了，只有黑色的。
M
Hmm, my teacher wants blue. I'll get a pen at the supermarket, then.
嗯，我们老师要求用蓝色的。那我去超市买笔吧。
F
OK. Do you need a bag?
好的。需要袋子吗？
M
No, thanks. Just the notebook.
不用了，谢谢。就要笔记本。
q: What will the man buy?
ex: 男生说 I'll take a large one，最后又说 Just the notebook。蓝笔卖完了要去超市买，黑笔老师不让用。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two roommates. What will the woman do first?
lines: M
Hey, are you going to the gym now?
嘿，你现在要去健身房吗？
F
Yes, but first I need to call my mom. It's her birthday today.
对，不过我得先给我妈打个电话，今天是她生日。
M
Oh, nice. Can you buy some milk on your way back?
哦，挺好。你回来的路上能买点牛奶吗？
F
Sure. Anything else?
行。还要别的吗？
M
No, just milk. Oh, and the laundry is done. Could you take your clothes out?
不用，就牛奶。哦，还有衣服洗好了，你能把你的衣服拿出来吗？
F
OK, I'll do that right after the call.
好的，打完电话我马上去拿。
q: What will the woman do first?
ex: 女生说 first I need to call my mom，拿衣服是 after the call，去健身房和买牛奶在更后面。

intro: Listen to the conversation. What will they do on Saturday?
lines: F
Do you have any plans for Saturday?
你周六有什么安排吗？
M
Not really. Why?
没什么安排。怎么了？
F
I want to go to the zoo. Do you want to come?
我想去动物园，你要一起去吗？
M
Hmm, the weather report says it'll rain all day on Saturday.
嗯，天气预报说周六一整天都下雨。
F
Oh no. Then how about the art museum?
哎呀。那去美术馆怎么样？
M
Good idea. And we can have lunch at the Italian place near it.
好主意。我们还可以在附近那家意大利餐厅吃午饭。
F
Great. Let's meet at eleven.
太好了，十一点见吧。
q: What will they do on Saturday?
c: Wait for the rain to stop
ex: 因为下雨，动物园改成了美术馆，午饭是在意大利餐厅吃，不是在家做。

intro: Listen to the conversation in the school cafeteria. What will the woman have?
lines: M
Hi, what would you like?
你好，想吃点什么？
F
I'd like the chicken curry, please.
我要鸡肉咖喱。
M
Sorry, the curry is all gone. We have beef noodles and fish with rice.
抱歉，咖喱卖完了。还有牛肉面和鱼肉饭。
F
I don't eat beef. I'll have the fish, then.
我不吃牛肉，那就要鱼吧。
M
Would you like soup with that? It's free today.
要配汤吗？今天免费。
F
Yes, please. Tomato soup.
好的，要番茄汤。
q: What will the woman have?
c: Fish with rice and tomato soup
ex: 咖喱卖完了，她不吃牛肉，所以点了鱼肉饭，又要了免费的番茄汤。

intro: Listen to the conversation at the campus post office. What will the man bring tomorrow?
lines: F
Hello, can I help you?
你好，有什么可以帮你？
M
Yes, I got a message that a package arrived for me.
是的，我收到消息说有我的包裹。
F
Can I see your student card?
能看一下你的学生证吗？
M
Here you are.
给你。
F
Hmm, the name on the package is different. It says Tom Green.
嗯，包裹上的名字不一样，写的是 Tom Green。
M
Oh, that's my brother. He sent it to me, but he wrote his own name.
哦，那是我哥哥。他寄给我的，但写了他自己的名字。
F
Then I need a letter from him saying you can pick it up.
那我需要他写一封信，说明你可以代领。
M
OK. I'll ask him to write one and come back tomorrow.
好的，我让他写一封，明天再来。
q: What will the man bring tomorrow?
ex: 工作人员要的是哥哥写的同意代领的信。学生证他今天已经出示过了，另外两项没有被要求。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two students. What will the woman do next?
lines: F
I tried to sign up for the photography course, but it's already full.
我想报摄影课，可是已经满了。
M
Did you put your name on the waiting list?
你登记候补名单了吗？
F
I did, but I'm number twelve. There's no chance.
登记了，可我排第十二，没希望。
M
Have you thought about the film studies course? It's on the same day.
你考虑过电影研究课吗？是同一天上。
F
I looked at it, but it clashes with my part-time job.
我看过了，但和我打工的时间冲突。
M
What about emailing the photography instructor? Sometimes they open an extra section if enough people ask.
那给摄影课老师发邮件呢？有时候要求的人多，他们会加开一个班。
F
That's worth a try. I'll do it right now, before the office closes.
值得试试。我现在就发，趁办公室还没下班。
q: What will the woman do next?
c: Put her name on the waiting list
ex: 她最后说 I'll do it right now，指给老师发邮件。候补名单已经登记过，电影课和打工冲突，她也没打算辞职。

intro: Listen to the conversation about a group project. What will the man do this evening?
lines: F
So we've got the survey results. Who's making the slides?
调查结果出来了。谁来做幻灯片？
M
I can, but I'm not very good with charts.
我可以做，但我不太会做图表。
F
Kevin's great with charts. Let's ask him to do those.
Kevin 图表做得很好，让他来做吧。
M
Good. Then I'll write the text for the slides tonight.
好。那我今晚写幻灯片的文字。
F
And I'll practice the introduction. Oh, we still need to book a room to rehearse.
我来练开场白。哦，我们还得订个房间排练。
M
I'll do that too. The booking system is down tonight, though, so I'll do it first thing tomorrow.
这个也我来。不过预订系统今晚维护，我明天一早就订。
q: What will the man do this evening?
c: Write the text for the slides
ex: 男生说 I'll write the text for the slides tonight。图表交给 Kevin，开场白由女生练，订房间要等到明天早上。

intro: Listen to the conversation at the campus gym. Which option will the woman choose?
lines: F
Hi, I'd like to join the gym. What options do you have?
你好，我想办健身房的卡，有哪些选择？
M
There's a monthly pass for thirty dollars, or a full semester for a hundred.
月卡三十美元，一整个学期一百美元。
F
The semester pass is cheaper in the long run, right?
长期来看学期卡更划算，对吧？
M
It is, if you come regularly. We also have a ten-visit card for twenty-five dollars.
如果你经常来的话是的。我们还有二十五美元的十次卡。
F
Honestly, I've got exams coming up, so I'll probably only come once a week.
说实话，我快考试了，大概一周只能来一次。
M
Then the ten-visit card might suit you better. It's valid for three months.
那十次卡可能更适合你，有效期三个月。
F
That makes sense. I'll take that one.
有道理，我就要这个。
q: Which option will the woman choose?
ex: 她一周只来一次，接受了工作人员推荐的十次卡。“三个月”只是十次卡的有效期，不是另一种卡。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a phone repair shop. What will the man do?
lines: M
Hi, my phone screen cracked. How much is a new screen?
你好，我的手机屏幕裂了。换个新屏多少钱？
F
For this model, about a hundred and twenty dollars.
这个型号大概一百二十美元。
M
Wow. The phone itself only cost me three hundred.
哇，手机本身才三百。
F
If you just want it to work, we can put a protective film over the crack for ten dollars.
如果只是想能用，我们可以花十美元在裂缝上贴一层保护膜。
M
But the touch screen doesn't respond at the bottom.
可是屏幕下面触摸没反应。
F
Then the film won't help, I'm afraid. You'd need a new screen, or you could trade it in for a discount on a new phone.
那贴膜恐怕没用。得换屏，或者你可以以旧换新，买新手机打折。
M
I'll go with the new screen. I only bought this phone last year.
那我换屏吧，这手机去年才买的。
q: What will the man do?
c: Put a film over the crack
Buy a new phone at full price
ex: 触屏失灵，贴膜没用；他说 I'll go with the new screen，因为手机去年才买，不想换新手机。

intro: Listen to the conversation. What will the woman do on Sunday?
lines: M
The animal shelter needs volunteers this weekend. Are you interested?
动物收容所这周末需要志愿者，你有兴趣吗？
F
Maybe. What would I have to do?
也许吧。要做什么？
M
On Saturday they need people to walk dogs, and on Sunday they're painting the fences.
周六需要人遛狗，周日要粉刷围栏。
F
I'm working at the café on Saturday. Sunday's free, though.
周六我要在咖啡馆打工，不过周日有空。
M
Great. Painting it is. Oh, they also want someone to take photos for their website.
太好了，那就刷围栏。哦，他们还想找人给网站拍照片。
F
I'm not much of a photographer. I'll leave that to someone else.
我不太会拍照，这个留给别人吧。
q: What will the woman do on Sunday?
c: Paint fences at the animal shelter
ex: 周日的工作是刷围栏，男生说 Painting it is。遛狗和打工都在周六，拍照她拒绝了。

intro: Listen to the conversation about an exchange program. What will the woman do first?
lines: F
I'm finally applying for the exchange program in Edinburgh. The deadline's the fifteenth.
我终于要申请爱丁堡的交换项目了，截止日期是十五号。
M
Have you got everything? Transcripts, recommendation letters, the personal statement?
材料都齐了吗？成绩单、推荐信、个人陈述？
F
The statement's drafted, and Professor Hall agreed to write a letter. The transcript's the problem. The registrar takes ten working days.
个人陈述写好初稿了，Hall 教授也答应写推荐信。问题是成绩单，教务处要十个工作日。
M
Ten days? That's cutting it close. You should request it before anything else.
十天？那时间很紧了。你应该先申请成绩单。
F
True. I was going to polish my statement this afternoon, but you're right.
确实。我本来打算今天下午润色个人陈述的，不过你说得对。
M
And remind Professor Hall. He's notoriously forgetful.
还要提醒一下 Hall 教授，他出了名的健忘。
F
I'll email him tonight. The transcript request comes first, though.
我今晚给他发邮件。不过先申请成绩单。
q: What will the woman do first?
cz: 给 Hall 教授发邮件
ex: 成绩单要十个工作日，时间最紧，她最后说 The transcript request comes first。润色陈述被推后，邮件今晚才发。

intro: Listen to the conversation about summer housing. What will the man most likely do?
lines: M
My lease runs until August, but I'm doing an internship in Shanghai over the summer.
我的租约到八月，可我暑假要去上海实习。
F
So you'll be paying rent for an empty flat for two months?
那你要为空房子付两个月房租？
M
Unless I find someone to sublet it. The landlord's fine with that, as long as I'm still responsible for any damage.
除非我找到人转租。房东同意，只要有损坏还是由我负责。
F
That's a bit risky. Why not just break the lease?
那有点冒险。为什么不干脆解约？
M
The penalty is two months' rent, so there's no point.
违约金是两个月房租，那就没意义了。
F
My cousin's coming here for a summer course. She's very tidy, I promise.
我表妹暑假要来这儿上课，她很爱干净，我保证。
M
Really? Then put us in touch. That'd save me posting ads online.
真的吗？那帮我们联系一下吧，省得我在网上发广告了。
q: What will the man most likely do?
c: Sublet the flat to the woman's cousin
cz: 把房子转租给女生的表妹
ex: 解约要付两个月房租的违约金，等于没省钱；女生表妹正好需要住处，他说 put us in touch，就不用再发广告了。

intro: Listen to the conversation in a research lab. What will the woman do next?
lines: M
How's your survey going? You needed two hundred responses, didn't you?
你的问卷怎么样了？你需要两百份回复，对吧？
F
I've only got ninety. Posting the link on social media didn't do much.
才九十份。把链接发到社交媒体上没什么用。
M
Have you tried handing out paper copies in the cafeteria?
你试过在食堂发纸质问卷吗？
F
I thought about it, but entering the data by hand would take ages.
想过，但手工录入数据要花太久了。
M
Fair enough. What about asking the department to put it in the student newsletter?
也是。那请院里把它放到学生通讯里呢？
F
Great idea, but the next issue isn't out for three weeks, and my supervisor wants results next Friday.
好主意，但下一期要三周后才出，导师下周五就要结果。
M
Then why not offer a small reward, like a coffee voucher? Our lab has a budget for that.
那为什么不给点小奖励，比如咖啡券？我们实验室有这笔预算。
F
Really? I'll go and ask the lab manager about it now.
真的吗？我现在就去问实验室主管。
q: What will the woman do next?
c: Post the link on social media again
Ask the lab manager about rewards
Hand out paper surveys in the cafeteria
cz: 再在社交媒体上发链接
去问实验室主管奖励的事
ex: 最后她说 I'll go and ask the lab manager about it now。纸质问卷录入太慢，通讯要三周后才出，社交媒体已经证明没用。

intro: Listen to the conversation at the tutoring center. What will the man do on Thursday?
lines: F
Hi, Mark. We need you to change your tutoring schedule next week.
嗨，Mark，下周你的辅导时间需要调整一下。
M
Oh? I usually tutor maths on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons.
哦？我一般是周二和周四下午辅导数学。
F
The Tuesday session's been cancelled because of the career fair. Could you cover a Wednesday evening instead?
周二的课因为招聘会取消了。你能改到周三晚上吗？
M
Wednesday evenings I have choir. But I could do Thursday morning as well as the afternoon.
周三晚上我有合唱团。不过周四上午和下午我都可以。
F
Thursday morning works. We've got a backlog of statistics students.
周四上午可以。我们积压了一批学统计的学生。
M
Statistics? I'm not really qualified for that. I'd rather stick with calculus.
统计？我不太够格。我还是教微积分吧。
F
Fine. I'll give the statistics students to Anna, and you'll take the calculus group.
行，统计的学生交给 Anna，你带微积分组。
q: What will the man do on Thursday?
c: Tutor calculus in the morning and afternoon
cz: 上午和下午都辅导微积分
ex: 他周四上午、下午都上课，统计学生交给了 Anna，他带微积分。合唱团在周三晚上，招聘会是周二课程取消的原因。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a party. Why is the man leaving early?
lines: F
Are you leaving already? The party just started.
你这就走了？聚会才刚开始。
M
Yes, sorry. I have to go.
是的，抱歉，我得走了。
F
Do you have a test tomorrow?
你明天有考试吗？
M
No, the test is next week. My dog is sick, and I need to take him to the vet.
不是，考试在下周。我的狗病了，我得带它去看兽医。
F
Oh no. I hope he gets better soon.
哎呀，希望它快点好起来。
q: Why is the man leaving early?
c: He has to study for next week's test
cz: 他得为下周的考试复习
ex: 男生说 My dog is sick，要带狗去看兽医。考试在下周，生病的是狗不是他自己。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a ticket desk. How much will the woman pay?
lines: F
Hi, I'd like tickets for the school concert on Friday.
你好，我想买周五学校音乐会的票。
M
Sure. Student tickets are five dollars, and adult tickets are ten.
好的。学生票五美元，成人票十美元。
F
I need two student tickets and one for my father.
我要两张学生票，再给我爸爸买一张。
M
OK. That's twenty dollars.
好的，一共二十美元。
F
Oh, wait. My mother wants to come too. One more adult ticket, please.
哦，等一下，我妈妈也想来。再加一张成人票。
M
All right. That's thirty dollars.
好的，一共三十美元。
q: How much will the woman pay?
ex: 两张学生票十美元，加两张成人票二十美元，共三十美元。二十美元是加妈妈的票之前的价格。

intro: Listen to the conversation. Where is the woman's phone?
lines: F
Have you seen my phone? I can't find it anywhere.
你看见我的手机了吗？我哪儿都找不到。
M
Did you look in your bag?
你看过包里了吗？
F
Yes, it's not there. And it's not on my desk.
看过了，不在。桌子上也没有。
M
Maybe you left it in the classroom.
也许你落在教室里了。
F
No, I used it after class to call my sister.
不会，下课后我还用它给我姐姐打电话了。
M
Wait, I can hear something. It's ringing under your jacket on the sofa!
等等，我听到声音了。在沙发上你的外套下面响呢！
q: Where is the woman's phone?
c: Under her jacket on the sofa
cz: 在沙发上她的外套下面
ex: 最后男生听到铃声，手机在沙发上的外套下面。包里、桌上都找过了，下课后她还用过手机，所以不在教室。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two classmates. Why did the woman start swimming?
lines: M
You look very healthy these days, Lily.
Lily，你最近气色真好。
F
Thanks. I started swimming last month.
谢谢，我上个月开始游泳了。
M
Swimming? I thought you liked tennis.
游泳？我以为你喜欢网球。
F
I still do, but I hurt my arm. The doctor said swimming is better for me.
我现在也喜欢，但我手臂受伤了，医生说游泳对我更好。
M
Do you swim every day?
你每天都游吗？
F
No, three times a week, before class.
不是，一周三次，在上课前。
q: Why did the woman start swimming?
c: She wants to swim every day
Her doctor said it was better for her
She has free time before class
ex: 她手臂受伤，医生说游泳更好。她仍然喜欢网球，一周游三次而不是每天。

intro: Listen to the conversation. Why is the woman quitting her job at the bookstore?
lines: M
I heard you're quitting your job at the bookstore. I thought you loved it.
听说你要辞掉书店的工作，我以为你很喜欢呢。
F
I do. My coworkers are great, and I get a discount on books.
我是喜欢。同事都很好，买书还有折扣。
M
Is the pay too low?
是工资太低吗？
F
Not really. It's about the same as other jobs. The problem is the hours. They keep giving me late shifts, and I'm missing my morning classes.
也不是，和别的工作差不多。问题是时间。他们总给我排晚班，害得我早上的课都去不了。
M
Couldn't you talk to your manager?
你不能跟经理谈谈吗？
F
I did, twice. Nothing changed. So I've applied at the library. It closes at six.
谈过两次了，没用。所以我申请了图书馆的工作，那里六点就关门。
q: Why is the woman quitting her job at the bookstore?
c: Her late shifts make her miss classes
ex: 她说 The problem is the hours，晚班让她错过早课。她对同事很满意，工资也和别处差不多，经理只是没帮她调班。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two students. Why did the man miss the lecture?
lines: F
You weren't in the economics lecture this morning. Were you ill?
今天上午的经济学课你没来，生病了吗？
M
No. I actually got to the building on time.
没有，我其实准时到了教学楼。
F
Then what happened?
那怎么回事？
M
The lecture had been moved to the new science hall, and I hadn't checked my email.
课挪到了新的理科楼，我没看邮件。
F
Oh, they announced that last Friday.
哦，上周五就通知了。
M
By the time I found the right room, the doors were closed, and I didn't want to interrupt.
等我找到教室，门已经关了，我不想打扰上课。
q: Why did the man miss the lecture?
c: He went to the wrong building
ex: 课换了地点而他没看邮件，所以去错了楼。他否认生病；邮件是发了但他没看，不是没收到；课并没有取消。

intro: Listen to the conversation. What does the woman like most about the new cafeteria?
lines: M
Have you tried the new cafeteria in the student center?
你去过学生中心新开的食堂吗？
F
Yes, I went yesterday. It's a lot bigger than the old one.
去过，昨天去的。比原来的大多了。
M
Is the food any good?
饭菜怎么样？
F
The salads are fresh, but the noodles were cold. And it's a bit more expensive.
沙拉挺新鲜，但面条是凉的，而且有点贵。
M
What about the waiting time? The old one always had long lines.
排队呢？原来那个总是排长队。
F
That's the best part. You order on a screen, so I got my food in five minutes.
这正是最好的地方。在屏幕上点餐，我五分钟就拿到饭了。
q: What does the woman like most about the new cafeteria?
ex: That's the best part 指的是不用排长队、五分钟拿到饭。沙拉新鲜、面积大也是优点，但不是最喜欢的；价格其实更贵。

intro: Listen to the announcement in the library. Where will the group study rooms be during the exam period?
lines: F
Attention, students. Starting next Monday, the main library will stay open twenty-four hours a day for the exam period.
同学们请注意。从下周一开始，考试期间总图书馆二十四小时开放。
F
However, the second floor will be closed for repairs, so the group study rooms will move to the first floor.
不过二楼因维修关闭，小组学习室将搬到一楼。
F
The café in the basement will close at ten p.m. as usual.
地下室的咖啡馆照常晚上十点关门。
F
After midnight, please use the main entrance and bring your student card, as you'll need it to enter the building.
午夜之后请走正门，并带上学生证，进楼时需要刷卡。
q: Where will the group study rooms be during the exam period?
ex: 广播说二楼维修，小组学习室搬到一楼。二楼是原来的位置，地下室是咖啡馆，正门是午夜后的入口。

intro: Listen to the conversation. Why did the man send the jacket back?
lines: F
Didn't you buy a jacket online last week? Why aren't you wearing it?
你上周不是在网上买了件夹克吗？怎么没穿？
M
I sent it back.
我退回去了。
F
Was it the wrong size?
尺码不对吗？
M
No, the size was perfect, and the color was just like the picture.
不是，尺码正合适，颜色也跟图片一样。
F
So what was wrong with it?
那有什么问题？
M
It said it was waterproof, but I wore it in the rain and got completely wet.
说是防水的，可我穿着淋了雨，全湿透了。
q: Why did the man send the jacket back?
c: The color was different from the picture
ex: 夹克号称防水，穿着淋雨却湿透了。尺码和颜色他都满意，到货时间没有问题。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two friends. Why is the man changing his major?
lines: F
I heard you're switching from law to computer science. That's quite a leap.
听说你要从法律转到计算机，跨度挺大的。
M
It is. Everyone assumes it's about money, but law pays perfectly well.
是啊。大家都以为是为了钱，但法律收入其实挺好的。
F
Then was it the workload? Your reading lists were enormous.
那是因为课业太重？你们的阅读书单可长了。
M
Honestly, I didn't mind the reading. What got to me was my internship last summer. I spent three months on paperwork and never once felt I was solving anything.
说实话，我不介意读书。让我受不了的是去年暑假的实习。我做了三个月文书工作，从没觉得自己解决过什么问题。
F
And coding feels different?
写代码感觉不一样？
M
When a program finally runs, I feel I've actually built something. That's what I want from a career.
程序终于跑起来的时候，我觉得自己真的造出了东西。这就是我想要的职业。
q: Why is the man changing his major?
c: He wants work where he solves problems and builds things
The law reading list was too heavy
cz: 他想做能解决问题、创造东西的工作
ex: 实习时只做文书、没有解决问题的感觉，而写程序让他觉得在创造。他明确否认是为了钱或阅读量，实习也没说失败。

intro: Listen to the news report. What led to the new night bus service?
lines: M
The city transit authority has announced that, starting in March, night buses will run between the university district and downtown until three a.m. on weekends.
市交通局宣布，从三月起，周末夜间公交将在大学区和市中心之间运行到凌晨三点。
M
The decision follows a petition signed by more than four thousand students, many of whom work late shifts in restaurants and shops.
这一决定是在四千多名学生联名请愿之后做出的，其中许多人在餐馆和商店上晚班。
M
Officials initially worried the service would be too costly, but the university has agreed to cover a third of the expense.
官员起初担心成本太高，但大学同意承担三分之一的费用。
M
Some local residents have raised concerns about noise, and the authority says it will review the route after six months.
一些当地居民担心噪音，交通局表示将在六个月后重新评估线路。
q: What led to the new night bus service?
c: A six-month review of bus routes
cz: 公交线路的六个月评估
ex: The decision follows a petition…，说明起因是学生请愿。居民投诉的是噪音，餐馆只是学生打工的地方，六个月评估是今后的安排。

intro: Listen to the conversation about a new course policy. What is the woman's main concern?
lines: M
Did you see the department's new policy? We're allowed to use AI tools for essays now, as long as we say how we used them.
你看到系里的新规定了吗？现在写论文可以用 AI 工具了，只要说明怎么用的就行。
F
I saw. I'm not sure it's a good idea, though.
看到了。不过我不确定这是不是好主意。
M
Because people will cheat?
因为大家会作弊？
F
Not really. The disclosure rule takes care of most of that. My worry is that if a tool organizes your argument for you, you never learn to do it yourself.
不完全是，说明用途的规定基本能解决这个问题。我担心的是，如果工具替你组织论点，你自己就永远学不会了。
M
But it saves so much time.
可是能省好多时间啊。
F
Sure. But when there's an exam in your final year with no tools allowed, you'll pay for that time.
没错。可等到毕业那年考试不让用工具的时候，省下的时间就要还回去了。
q: What is the woman's main concern?
c: The disclosure rule is too strict
AI tools waste too much time
Students won't learn to build arguments themselves
cz: 说明用途的规定太严格
学生学不会自己组织论点
ex: 她说 My worry is that…you never learn to do it yourself。她认为作弊问题已由说明规定解决，也承认工具能省时间。

intro: Listen to the conversation with an academic advisor. What does the advisor suggest?
lines: F
So, you're thinking of taking a year off before your final year?
你是在考虑最后一年之前休学一年？
M
Yes. A start-up has offered me a job, and they want me full-time for twelve months.
是的。一家初创公司给了我工作机会，他们要我全职干十二个月。
F
That's a great opportunity. The risk is that students who take a whole year off sometimes never come back.
这是个好机会。风险是休学整整一年的学生有时就再也不回来了。
M
I'm sure I'd come back.
我肯定会回来的。
F
Everyone says that. What if you asked the company for a six-month contract and took your remaining courses part-time online?
每个人都这么说。你何不问问公司能否签六个月的合同，剩下的课在网上兼读？
M
I hadn't thought of that. They did say they were flexible.
我没想到这个。他们确实说过可以灵活安排。
q: What does the advisor suggest?
c: Work for six months and study part-time online
Finish his degree before starting work
cz: 工作六个月，同时在网上兼读
ex: 顾问建议签六个月合同、剩余课程在线兼读。她肯定这是好机会，并没让他拒绝，只是担心休学一整年的风险。

intro: Listen to the conversation about a textbook program. According to the woman, why did grades improve?
lines: F
Did you hear about the pilot program in the chemistry department? They replaced the expensive textbooks with free online ones.
你听说化学系的试点项目了吗？他们把昂贵的教材换成了免费的在线教材。
M
I assumed it was just to save students money.
我以为只是为了给学生省钱。
F
That was the goal. But the surprising part is that grades went up, too.
初衷是这样。但出人意料的是成绩也提高了。
M
Because the free books were better?
因为免费的书更好？
F

Not according to the professors. They said the content was about the same. The difference was that everyone had the book from day one. Before, lots of students waited weeks to buy it, or never bought it at all.
教授们说不是，内容差不多。区别在于每个人从第一天起就有书了。以前很多学生拖好几周才买，或者干脆不买。
M
So it's about access rather than quality.
所以关键是能否拿到书，而不是质量。
q: According to the woman, why did grades improve?
c: Students had the book from the first day
cz: 学生从第一天起就有书
ex: 关键是 everyone had the book from day one。教授说内容差不多，省钱是项目初衷而非成绩提高的原因。

intro: A student is talking about her roommate.
lines: F
My roommate, Jess, is from Canada. We have lived together for two months.
我的室友 Jess 来自加拿大，我们一起住了两个月了。
F
At first, it was difficult. I like to go to bed early, but she likes to stay up late.
一开始很难。我喜欢早睡，她喜欢熬夜。
F
So we made some rules. After eleven, she uses headphones and a small lamp.
所以我们定了些规矩。十一点以后她戴耳机、开小台灯。
F
Now we get along very well. On weekends, we cook dinner together.
现在我们相处得很好，周末还一起做晚饭。
q: What is the woman mainly talking about?
c: Why she goes to bed early
How she and her roommate learned to live together
cz: 她和室友如何学会和睦相处
ex: 她讲了和室友作息不同、定规矩、现在相处很好的过程。加拿大、做饭、早睡都只是细节。

intro: A man is talking about his part-time job.
lines: M
I work at a pizza restaurant three evenings a week.
我每周有三个晚上在一家比萨店打工。
M
I take orders on the phone and sometimes help in the kitchen.
我接电话订单，有时也去厨房帮忙。
M
The work is busy, but I've learned a lot. I can make pizza now!
工作很忙，但我学到了很多，现在我会做比萨了！
M
I also learned how to talk to customers politely.
我还学会了怎么礼貌地和顾客说话。
M
With the money, I'm saving for a trip to Japan next summer.
挣的钱我存着，打算明年夏天去日本旅行。
q: What is the man mainly talking about?
c: How to take orders on the phone
What he does and learns at his part-time job
cz: 他打工做什么、学到了什么
ex: 整段围绕他在比萨店打工的内容和收获。做比萨、接电话、去日本都是其中的细节。

intro: Listen to an announcement at a school.
lines: F
Good afternoon, students. This is an announcement about Sports Day.
同学们下午好，现在播送关于运动会的通知。
F
Because of the heavy rain this week, the field is too wet.
由于本周下大雨，操场太湿了。
F
So Sports Day will move from this Friday to next Wednesday.
所以运动会从本周五改到下周三。
F
Classes will be held as usual this Friday, so please bring your textbooks.
本周五照常上课，请带好课本。
F
The time and the events will not change. Thank you.
时间和比赛项目不变。谢谢。
q: What is the announcement mainly about?
c: A change in the date of Sports Day
ex: 通知的核心是运动会从周五改到下周三。下雨是原因，带课本是附带说明，比赛项目不变。

intro: A university student is talking about his life.
lines: M
When I started university, I always ran out of money at the end of the month.
刚上大学时，我每到月底钱就花光了。
M
So I made a few changes. Now I cook at home instead of eating out.
所以我做了一些改变。现在我在家做饭，不去外面吃。
M
I buy used textbooks from older students.
我从学长学姐那里买二手教材。
M
And I ride my bike to school, so I don't pay for the bus.
我还骑车上学，省了公交费。
M
Now I can save about fifty dollars every month.
现在我每个月能存下大约五十美元。
q: What is the man mainly talking about?
c: Why he likes riding a bike
ex: 他列举了做饭、买二手书、骑车几种办法，目的都是省钱。各个选项中的具体做法只是例子。

intro: Listen to part of a radio program.
lines: M
If you feel sleepy after lunch, you're not lazy. It's a natural dip in the body's energy.
如果午饭后犯困，那不是懒，而是身体能量自然的低谷。
M
Research suggests that a short nap of fifteen to twenty minutes can improve memory and attention for the rest of the afternoon.
研究表明，十五到二十分钟的小睡能提高整个下午的记忆力和注意力。
M
But timing matters. Sleep longer than half an hour, and you may wake up feeling worse.
但时机很重要。睡超过半小时，醒来可能感觉更糟。
M
And napping too late in the day can make it harder to fall asleep at night.
而且太晚午睡会让晚上更难入睡。
M
So if you nap, keep it short, and take it early in the afternoon.
所以如果要午睡，就睡短一点，并且在下午早些时候睡。
q: What is the speaker mainly talking about?
c: How to nap in a way that helps you
How to fall asleep at night
Why people feel sleepy after lunch
ex: 节目介绍短睡的好处以及时长、时间点的注意事项，结论是“睡短、睡早”。饭后犯困、晚上入睡都只是其中一部分。

intro: A woman is speaking at a student union meeting.
lines: F
As many of you know, our campus throws away thousands of coffee cups every week.
大家都知道，我们校园每周要扔掉数千个咖啡杯。
F
Starting next month, the student union will sell reusable cups at the bookstore for just two dollars.
从下个月起，学生会将在书店以两美元的价格出售可重复使用的杯子。
F
If you bring one to any campus café, you'll get fifty cents off your drink.
带着它去校内任何一家咖啡馆，饮料都能便宜五十美分。
F
We'll also put new recycling bins in every building, with clear signs showing what goes where.
我们还会在每栋楼放置新的回收箱，并配上清晰的分类标识。
F
We hope these small changes will cut our waste in half by the end of the year.
我们希望这些小改变能在年底前把垃圾减少一半。
q: What is the woman mainly talking about?
c: Plans to reduce waste on campus
The price of coffee on campus
ex: 可重复使用的杯子和回收箱都是为了把垃圾减半。书店、咖啡价格、分类标识都只是计划中的细节。

intro: Listen to a news report.
lines: F
The public library in Greenfield has started lending something other than books: tools.
Greenfield 公共图书馆开始外借书以外的东西：工具。
F
Residents with a library card can now borrow drills, ladders, and even sewing machines for up to a week.
持借书证的居民现在可以借电钻、梯子，甚至缝纫机，最长一周。
F
Library staff say the idea came from people who needed a tool only once or twice a year and didn't want to buy one.
馆员说，这个想法来自那些一年只用一两次工具、又不想买的人。
F
In the first month, more than three hundred items were borrowed.
第一个月就借出了三百多件。
F
The library plans to add camping gear and kitchen equipment next spring.
图书馆计划明年春天增加露营装备和厨房用具。
q: What is the news report mainly about?
c: How to use a drill safely
A library that lends out tools
cz: 一家出借工具的图书馆
ex: 报道介绍图书馆开始借出工具的做法、起因和效果。电钻、露营装备、借书证都只是其中提到的细节。

intro: Listen to part of a lecture.
lines: F
Most students prepare for exams the same way: they study intensively the night before.
大多数学生都用同一种方式备考：考前一晚突击。
F
It feels productive, and you may even pass the test the next day.
这让人觉得很有效率，第二天甚至可能考及格。
F
But decades of memory research show that information learned this way fades rapidly.
但几十年的记忆研究表明，这样学到的东西很快就会忘掉。
F
When the same amount of study is spread over several days, with gaps in between, people remember far more weeks later.
如果把同样的学习量分散到几天，中间留出间隔，几周后记住的会多得多。
F
The gaps force the brain to work harder to retrieve the information, and that effort is what strengthens memory.
间隔迫使大脑更努力地提取信息，正是这种努力巩固了记忆。
F
So the next time you plan your revision, think less about how many hours, and more about how they're distributed.
所以下次安排复习时，少想学多少小时，多想想这些时间怎么分配。
q: What is the main idea of the lecture?
c: Spreading study over time improves long-term memory
Studying the night before helps you pass exams
Students should study for more hours
Memory research has a long history
cz: 把学习分散开能增强长期记忆
考前一晚学习有助于通过考试
学生应该增加学习时长
ex: 讲座指出突击记得快忘得也快，分散学习记得更久，结论是关注时间分配而非时长。“考前突击能及格”是被反驳的观点。

intro: Listen to part of a radio program.
lines: M
When we think about what makes us happy, we tend to focus on close friends and family.
说到什么让我们快乐，我们往往想到亲密的朋友和家人。
M
But researchers have found that so-called weak ties, like the barista who knows your order or the classmate you chat with before lectures, matter more than we think.
但研究者发现，所谓的“弱关系”，比如记得你点什么的咖啡师、课前闲聊的同学，比我们想象的更重要。
M
In one study, people who had more of these brief, casual interactions reported feeling happier and more connected on those days.
一项研究中，那些有更多简短、随意交流的人表示，当天感觉更快乐、更有归属感。
M
These small exchanges remind us that we belong to a wider community.
这些小小的交流提醒我们，自己属于一个更大的群体。
M
So instead of looking at your phone in the queue, try saying hello. It may lift your mood more than you'd expect.
所以排队时别光看手机，试着打个招呼，它对心情的提升可能超出你的预期。
q: What is the speaker mainly talking about?
c: The dangers of using phones in public
The value of brief, casual social contact
How to make close friends at university
cz: 在公共场所用手机的危害
咖啡师为什么记得顾客点什么
简短随意的社交接触的价值
怎样在大学交到好朋友
ex: 节目的中心是“弱关系”带来的快乐。亲密朋友是用来对比的，咖啡师是例子，看手机只是结尾的建议。

intro: Listen to part of a talk.
lines: F
A few years ago, several American universities quietly removed trays from their dining halls.
几年前，几所美国大学悄悄撤掉了食堂里的托盘。
F
The reasoning was simple: when students carry a tray, they tend to pile on more food than they can eat.
理由很简单：学生端着托盘时，往往会盛下吃不完的饭菜。
F
Without one, they take only what they can carry and go back if they're still hungry.
没有托盘，他们只拿手里拿得下的，饿了再回去拿。
F
Studies at these campuses found that food waste dropped by roughly a quarter, and less water was needed for washing up.
这些学校的研究发现，食物浪费减少了约四分之一，洗碗用水也少了。
F
Some students complained at first, but most quickly adapted.
起初有些学生抱怨，但大多数人很快就适应了。
F
It's a reminder that small changes to our surroundings can shape behavior more effectively than lectures about saving resources.
这提醒我们，对环境做小小的改变，比宣讲节约资源更能有效地影响行为。
q: What is the main point of the talk?
c: Small changes to our surroundings can change behavior
Students dislike new rules at first
cz: 对环境的小改变能改变人的行为
学生起初不喜欢新规定
ex: 最后一句点明主旨：环境的小改变比说教更能影响行为。节水、学生抱怨都只是撤托盘的结果或细节。

intro: Listen to a news report.
lines: M
In several European cities, a housing program is pairing university students with elderly residents who have spare rooms.
在欧洲几座城市，一个住房项目正把大学生和家有空房的老人配对。
M
Students pay little or no rent. In exchange, they agree to spend a few hours a week with their hosts, sharing meals, helping with shopping, or simply chatting.
学生只付很少的房租甚至免租，作为交换，他们每周花几个小时陪房东，一起吃饭、帮忙购物或只是聊天。
M
Organizers say the arrangement tackles two problems at once: the shortage of affordable student housing, and the loneliness many older people experience.
组织者说，这一安排同时解决了两个问题：学生住房紧缺且昂贵，以及许多老人的孤独。
M
Participants are carefully matched based on their habits and interests, and either side can end the arrangement with a month's notice.
参与者根据生活习惯和兴趣仔细配对，任何一方提前一个月通知即可结束安排。
M
Several cities in Asia are now considering similar schemes.
亚洲的几座城市也在考虑类似的计划。
q: What is the report mainly about?
c: A program in which students live with older people
How to find a good roommate
The high cost of living in Europe
cz: 让学生和老人同住的项目
ex: 报道介绍学生与老人同住的项目及其好处。住房贵和孤独是它解决的问题，而且孤独指的是老人，不是学生。

lines: F
Excuse me, which gate does the flight to Chicago leave from?
打扰一下，飞芝加哥的航班在哪个登机口？
c: It's Gate twelve, just down on the left.
Yes, I flew to Chicago last year.
cz: 十二号登机口，往前走左手边就是。
是的，我去年飞过芝加哥。
ex: 问的是哪个登机口，回答登机口位置才对。第二项回答的是时间，第三项只抓住了 Chicago 和 fly。

lines: M
Can I leave my bags here until check-in time?
入住时间之前我能把行李寄存在这儿吗？
c: Sure, we'll keep them behind the desk.
No, I didn't bring any bags.
cz: 当然，我们帮您放在前台后面。
ex: 客人请求寄存行李，前台答应并说明放哪里最自然。第二项只重复了 check-in，第三项把说话人弄反了。

lines: F
Have you sent the email to the new client yet?
你给新客户发邮件了吗？
c: Yes, the client is very new.
I'll buy you a new one.
Not yet. I'll do it right after lunch.
ex: 问事情做了没有，回答“还没，午饭后发”最自然。另外两项只是重复了 new 和 client。

lines: M
How much is a round-trip ticket to the airport?
去机场的往返票多少钱？
ex: How much 问价钱，只有第一项回答了价格；第二项答的是时间，第三项答的是站台。

lines: F
Is the meeting room free this afternoon?
今天下午会议室空着吗？
c: Let me check the booking list.
ex: free 在这里是“空闲、没人用”，查一下预约表是合理回应。第二项把 free 理解成“免费”，第三项答非所问。

lines: M
I'm afraid your flight has been delayed by two hours.
很抱歉，您的航班延误了两个小时。
c: I booked it two hours ago.
Oh no. Is there somewhere I can wait?
ex: 航班延误，问哪里可以等候最自然。第二项与“延误”矛盾，第三项只是重复了 two hours。

lines: F
Would you mind proofreading my presentation slides before Friday?
你介意在周五前帮我校对一下演示文稿吗？
c: Yes, I'd love to present on Friday.
Not at all. Send them over.
Sorry, I didn't see your presentation.
cz: 是的，我很想周五做报告。
一点也不介意，发过来吧。
ex: Would you mind…? 表示同意要说 Not at all。第二项误以为是请他做报告，第三项把“校对”听成了“看报告”。

lines: M
Did you catch the weather report this morning?
今天早上的天气预报你听了吗？
c: No, I didn't catch the train.
Yeah, they said a storm is coming tonight.
The report is on my desk.
ex: catch the weather report 意思是“听到/看到天气预报”。第二项把 catch 理解成“赶上（车）”，第三项把 report 当成了书面报告。

lines: F
The manager wants us to work late again tonight.
经理又要我们今晚加班。
c: Seriously? That's the third time this week.
cz: 真的假的？这周都第三次了。
ex: 听到又要加班，抱怨“这周第三次了”最自然。第二项与加班矛盾，第三项只抓住了 manager。

lines: M
Make sure you are back at the bus by four thirty.
务必四点半之前回到大巴上。
ex: 导游提醒集合时间，确认时间是正确回应。第二项把 four 当成数量，第三项只是谈论大巴。

lines: F
I'd have applied for the position if I'd known it involved so much travel.
要是早知道这个职位要经常出差，我就申请了。
c: Good thing you didn't get the job, then.
Yes, the trip was far too long.
So you'd actually enjoy being on the road?
cz: 那幸好你没得到这份工作。
这么说你其实喜欢到处跑？
ex: 虚拟语气说明她其实喜欢出差、后悔没申请，追问“你喜欢在外奔波？”最贴切。第二项误以为她讨厌出差，第三项把 travel 当成一次旅行。

lines: M
The board is unlikely to approve the budget unless we cut marketing costs.
除非我们削减营销费用，否则董事会不太可能批准预算。
c: Then let's see where we can trim spending.
Great, so the budget's already approved.
Marketing has never been my strong point.
cz: 那我们看看哪里能压缩开支。
营销从来不是我的强项。
ex: unless 表示条件：要先削减费用，所以“看看哪里能压缩开支”是合理回应。第二项误解了 unlikely to approve，第三项偏离话题。

lines: F
Hardly had I landed when the airline called to say my suitcase was in Paris.
我刚一落地，航空公司就打电话说我的箱子在巴黎。
c: What a nightmare! Did they say when it would arrive?
So you flew to Paris after all?
cz: 真够糟的！他们说什么时候能送到吗？
所以你最后还是飞去巴黎了？
ex: Hardly…when 表示“一……就”，行李被送错了地方，表示同情并询问何时送到最自然。第二项误以为是她本人去了巴黎，第三项不合逻辑。

lines: M
That lecture on climate policy was a bit over my head, to be honest.
说实话，那场关于气候政策的讲座我有点听不懂。
c: Then you must have found it far too easy.
Same here. The economics part completely lost me.
I know, the speaker was really tall.
cz: 那你一定觉得太简单了。
我也是，经济学那部分我完全听晕了。
我知道，那个讲者个子很高。
ex: over my head 意为“太难、听不懂”，附和“我也是”最自然。第二项意思正好相反，第三项按字面理解成“高”。

lines: F
You couldn't have picked a worse time to ask for a raise.
你挑这个时候要求加薪，真是再糟糕不过了。
c: Thanks, I thought it was perfect timing.
I know, with all the layoffs going on.
I'll pick a better gift next time.
cz: 谢谢，我也觉得时机正好。
我知道，正赶上公司在裁员。
下次我挑个更好的礼物。
ex: couldn't have picked a worse time 是说时机最糟，承认“正赶上裁员”最合理。第二项误以为是夸奖，第三项只抓住了 pick。

lines: M
Apparently, the new subway extension won't open until the end of next year at the earliest.
听说新地铁延长线最早也要到明年年底才开通。
c: Another delay? They promised it would be done this spring.
Great, so I can start using it next week.
I'll extend my stay until next year, then.
cz: 又推迟了？他们承诺今年春天完工的。
太好了，那我下周就能坐了。
那我就把逗留时间延长到明年。
ex: not…until…at the earliest 表示还要很久，抱怨又延期最自然。第二项理解反了，第三项只抓住了 extension 和 next year。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a train station. Which ticket will the woman buy?
lines: F
Hello, I'd like a ticket to Oxford, please.
你好，我要一张去牛津的票。
M
Single or return?
单程还是往返？
F
Return, please. I'm coming back tonight.
往返，我今晚就回来。
M
The next train leaves at nine fifteen. A return ticket is twenty-four pounds.
下一班九点十五分开，往返票二十四英镑。
F
Hmm, is there a cheaper one?
嗯，有便宜点的吗？
M
If you take the ten o'clock train, it's only eighteen pounds.
如果坐十点那班，只要十八英镑。
F
OK, I'll take that one, then.
好，那我就买那班的。
q: Which ticket will the woman buy?
c: A return ticket for the nine fifteen train
A single ticket for the ten o'clock train
A single ticket for the nine fifteen train
A return ticket for the ten o'clock train
cz: 九点十五那班的往返票
九点十五那班的单程票
ex: 她今晚要回来，所以买往返票；嫌九点十五那班贵，改坐十点那班。

intro: Listen to the conversation in an office. What will the man do first?
lines: F
Mike, can you help me get ready for the meeting this afternoon?
迈克，你能帮我准备一下今天下午的会吗？
M
Sure. What do you need?
当然，需要做什么？
F
Please make twenty copies of this report.
请把这份报告复印二十份。
M
OK. Should I also set up the projector?
好的。我要不要也把投影仪装好？
F
Tom will do that. But could you buy some water for the guests first? We don't have any.
汤姆会弄的。不过你能先给客人买点水吗？我们一瓶都没有了。
M
No problem. I'll go to the shop now and make the copies when I get back.
没问题，我现在就去商店，回来再复印。
q: What will the man do first?
ex: 女士请他先买水，他说现在去商店、回来再复印。投影仪由汤姆负责。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a hotel. What will the woman do next?
lines: F
Hi, the air conditioner in my room isn't working. It's really hot.
你好，我房间的空调坏了，太热了。
M
I'm sorry about that. I'll send someone to fix it, but it will take about an hour.
很抱歉。我会派人去修，不过大约要一个小时。
F
An hour? I'm very tired. I want to go to sleep.
一个小时？我很累，想睡觉了。
M
Then we can move you to another room right now. Room five-oh-eight is ready.
那我们现在就给您换个房间，五零八号房已经准备好了。
F
That's great. Do I need to pack my things?
太好了。我需要收拾东西吗？
M
Yes, please. A staff member will come and carry your bags for you.
是的，麻烦您了。会有工作人员来帮您搬行李。
q: What will the woman do next?
c: Wait for the air conditioner to be fixed
Go to sleep in her room
Carry her bags to the front desk
ex: 她决定换房，前台让她先收拾东西，行李由工作人员来搬。她不愿意等一小时修空调。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a tourist information center. Where will the man go first?
lines: M
Excuse me. I only have one day in town. What should I see?
打扰一下，我在这儿只待一天，该去看什么？
F
The castle is very popular. But it's crowded in the afternoon, so go there in the morning.
城堡很受欢迎，不过下午人多，最好上午去。
M
OK. What about the art museum?
好的。美术馆呢？
F
It's closed on Mondays, and today is Monday.
美术馆周一闭馆，今天正好是周一。
M
Oh no. And the market?
哎呀。那市场呢？
F
The market opens at noon. You can have lunch at a restaurant there after the castle.
市场中午开门。看完城堡你可以去那里的餐馆吃午饭。
q: Where will the man go first?
ex: 城堡下午人多，建议上午先去；美术馆今天闭馆，市场中午才开，午饭在城堡之后。

intro: Listen to the conversation at an airport check-in counter. What will the woman do?
lines: M
Good morning. Where are you flying today?
早上好，您今天飞哪里？
F
To Tokyo. Here's my passport.
东京，这是我的护照。
M
Thank you. Are you checking this suitcase?
谢谢。这个箱子要托运吗？
F
Yes. And I want to take this small bag on the plane.
是的。这个小包我想带上飞机。
M
That's fine. But your suitcase is twenty-five kilos. The limit is twenty-three. You can pay fifty dollars extra, or take something out.
可以。不过您的箱子二十五公斤，限重二十三公斤。您可以多付五十美元，或者拿出一些东西。
F
Fifty dollars? That's too much. I'll take out these books and put them in my small bag.
五十美元？太贵了。我把这些书拿出来放进小包里。
q: What will the woman do?
c: Move some books into her small bag
Check in her small bag too
Put some books into her suitcase
ex: 箱子超重，她嫌五十美元太贵，决定把书从箱子里拿出来放进随身小包。方向不要听反。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two coworkers. What will the woman do this afternoon?
lines: M
Rachel, have you finished the sales figures for the quarterly report?
雷切尔，季度报告的销售数据你做完了吗？
F
Almost. I was planning to finish them this afternoon.
差不多了，我打算今天下午做完。
M
Actually, something more urgent has come up. The client in Singapore wants a video call at three.
其实有件更急的事。新加坡的客户想在三点开视频会议。
F
Today? I thought it was scheduled for Thursday.
今天？我以为定在周四。
M
They moved it. Could you prepare a short summary of our proposal for the call?
他们改时间了。你能为这次通话准备一份我们方案的简要说明吗？
F
Sure. Then I'll do the sales figures tomorrow morning.
好的。那销售数据我明天上午再做。
M
That's fine. And don't worry about booking a meeting room. I've already done it.
没问题。会议室不用你订，我已经订好了。
q: What will the woman do this afternoon?
c: Prepare a summary of the proposal
ex: 视频会议提前到今天三点，她下午要准备方案说明；销售数据推到明天上午，会议室男士已订好。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a car rental office. Which car will the man rent?
lines: M
Hi, I'd like to rent a car for the weekend. Something small and cheap.
你好，我想租一辆车过周末，要小一点、便宜点的。
F
Our compact cars are thirty-five dollars a day, but they're all booked this weekend.
我们的紧凑型车每天三十五美元，不过这个周末都被订完了。
M
Oh. What else do you have?
哦，那还有什么车？
F
There's a mid-size sedan for fifty dollars, or an SUV for seventy.
有一辆五十美元的中型轿车，或者七十美元的越野车。
M
I'm driving up into the mountains, and they say it might snow.
我要开车上山，听说可能会下雪。
F
In that case, I'd really recommend the SUV. It has four-wheel drive.
那样的话，我很推荐越野车，它是四轮驱动的。
M
Seventy is more than I planned, but I'd rather be safe. I'll take it.
七十美元超出预算了，不过还是安全第一，就租它吧。
q: Which car will the man rent?
cz: 三十五美元的紧凑型车
ex: 紧凑型车已订完；因为山里可能下雪，他选了七十美元、四轮驱动的越野车。

intro: Listen to the conversation between a new employee and an office manager. What will the man do first on Monday?
lines: F
Welcome aboard, Daniel. Before you start on Monday, let me go over a few things.
欢迎加入，丹尼尔。你周一上班前，我先跟你说几件事。
M
Great, thanks.
好的，谢谢。
F
First thing on Monday, go to the IT office on the second floor to pick up your laptop.
周一一到就先去二楼的IT办公室领笔记本电脑。
M
Should I go to HR to sign my contract first?
我是不是应该先去人事部签合同？
F
You signed it online, so there's no need. After IT, there's a safety training session at ten.
你已经在网上签过了，不用去。去完IT，十点有安全培训。
M
And when do I meet my team?
那我什么时候见团队？
F
At lunch. Your manager is taking everyone out.
午饭时，你的经理请大家出去吃。
q: What will the man do first on Monday?
ex: 周一第一件事是去IT办公室领电脑；合同已在网上签了，安全培训和午饭都在之后。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a lost-and-found office in a train station. What will the woman do first?
lines: F
Hello, I left my jacket on the train from Boston about an hour ago.
你好，我大约一小时前把夹克落在从波士顿来的火车上了。
M
Which train was it?
是哪一班车？
F
The two fifteen. It's a black jacket with my keys in the pocket.
两点十五分那班。是件黑夹克，口袋里有我的钥匙。
M
Let me check. Nothing has been handed in yet. Trains are cleaned at the last stop, so it may turn up later.
我查一下……还没有人交过来。火车到终点站会打扫，可能晚点会找到。
F
Should I wait here?
我要在这里等吗？
M
It could take hours. Fill in this form with your phone number, and we'll call you if it's found.
可能要好几个小时。填一下这张表，写上电话，找到了我们通知您。
F
OK. I'll do that, and then I'll call my landlord about a spare key.
好的，我先填表，然后给房东打电话要备用钥匙。
q: What will the woman do first?
c: Take the train back to Boston
ex: 工作人员说等可能要几小时，让她填表；她说先填表，然后再给房东打电话。

intro: Listen to the conversation in an office. What will the man order?
lines: F
Ken, we're running low on supplies. Can you place an order today?
肯，办公用品快用完了，你今天能下个订单吗？
M
Sure. Paper, right?
好的，是纸吧？
F
Actually, a box of paper arrived yesterday. It's printer ink we need. Black ink.
其实昨天刚到了一箱纸。我们缺的是打印机墨盒，黑色的。
M
How many cartridges?
要几个墨盒？
F
Three should be enough. Oh, and the colored ink is fine for now.
三个应该够了。哦，彩色墨盒暂时还够用。
M
Got it. What about pens? The drawer looked empty.
明白。笔呢？抽屉好像空了。
F
The company is switching to tablets next month, so don't bother.
公司下个月要改用平板电脑了，不用买了。
q: What will the man order?
ex: 纸昨天刚到，彩色墨盒够用，笔也不用买，只需要订三个黑色墨盒。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two colleagues. What will the woman do next?
lines: M
Have you sorted out your trip to the trade fair in Berlin yet?
你去柏林展会的行程安排好了吗？
F
Sort of. The direct flight on Monday is fully booked, so I was going to fly via Amsterdam.
算是吧。周一的直飞航班满了，所以我打算经阿姆斯特丹转机。
M
That's a four-hour layover, isn't it? You'd miss the opening reception.
那要转机四个小时吧？你会错过开幕招待会的。
F
I know. The other option is going on Sunday, but then I'd need an extra night at the hotel, and finance is strict about that.
我知道。另一个办法是周日走，但那样就得多住一晚酒店，财务部对这个卡得很严。
M
Actually, finance approved extra nights for the fair this year, since hotels in Berlin fill up so quickly. Check the memo.
其实今年财务部已经批准展会可以多住，因为柏林的酒店订得特别快。你看看那份通知。
F
Really? Then I'll go on Sunday and save myself the hassle. I'll email the hotel to add a night.
真的？那我周日走，省得麻烦。我这就给酒店发邮件加订一晚。
q: What will the woman do next?
c: Ask finance to approve an extra night
Email the hotel to extend her booking
cz: 预订经阿姆斯特丹转机的航班
请财务部批准多住一晚
给酒店发邮件延长预订
ex: 得知财务部已批准多住，她决定周日出发，接下来给酒店发邮件加订一晚；不需要再向财务申请。

intro: Listen to two organizers planning a charity run. What will the woman do?
lines: F
We need to finalize the route for the charity run. The riverside path is beautiful, but it's narrow.
慈善跑的路线得定下来了。河边小路很美，但太窄。
M
With eight hundred runners registered, it'd be a real bottleneck at the start.
报名的有八百人，起跑时肯定会堵住。
F
What about the park loop? It's wide, but people would have to run it three times.
公园环线呢？够宽，但要跑三圈。
M
Runners hate laps, though. What if we start in the park and join the river path once the crowd has spread out?
可跑者最讨厌绕圈。要不从公园起跑，等人群拉开后再接上河边小路？
F
That could work. We'd need extra volunteers where the two routes meet.
这个可行。两条路交汇的地方得多安排志愿者。
M
I'll contact the volunteer group tonight. Could you check with the city whether we need a separate permit for the path?
我今晚联系志愿者团队。你能问问市政府河边小路是否需要单独的许可吗？
F
Will do.
好的。
q: What will the woman do?
c: Change the route to the park loop only
Check whether a permit is needed
cz: 把路线改成只跑公园环线
ex: 男士负责联系志愿者，请女士向市政府确认是否需要许可。路线是公园加河边，不只是公园环线。

intro: Listen to the conversation between a scientist and her research assistant. What will the man do?
lines: M
Dr. Patel, the lake samples came back. Two of them show unusually high nitrate levels.
帕特尔博士，湖水样本结果出来了，有两个硝酸盐含量异常高。
F
Which sites?
哪两个采样点？
M
Sites four and seven, both near the farmland.
四号和七号，都在农田附近。
F
Before we draw any conclusions, I want those two retested. They may have been contaminated during transport.
下结论之前，我要这两个重新检测，可能是运输过程中被污染了。
M
Should I send them back to the same lab?
要送回同一个实验室吗？
F
No, use the university lab this time, so we have an independent result. And hold off on drafting the report until then.
不，这次用大学的实验室，这样结果更独立。在那之前先别写报告。
M
Understood. I'll arrange the retest today.
明白，我今天就安排复检。
q: What will the man do?
c: Send the samples to the university lab
Send the samples back to the same lab
Collect new samples near the farmland
cz: 把样本送到大学实验室
在农田附近采集新样本
ex: 博士要求换大学实验室复检以获得独立结果，并暂缓写报告。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two coworkers. What will the man do next?
lines: F
Did you hear? The rail workers are going on strike tomorrow, so your train to Edinburgh is cancelled.
你听说了吗？铁路工人明天罢工，你去爱丁堡的火车取消了。
M
You're kidding. My presentation is at two.
开玩笑吧，我两点要做报告。
F
You could fly. There's a seven a.m. flight, but it's nearly three hundred pounds.
你可以坐飞机。早上七点有一班，但要将近三百英镑。
M
Ouch. What about the coach?
好贵。那长途大巴呢？
F
It takes nine hours. You'd have to leave tonight.
要九个小时，你今晚就得出发。
M
Hmm. Actually, the client did say they'd be happy to do it by video. That's probably the most sensible option.
嗯……其实客户说过可以用视频做。这可能是最明智的办法。
F
I'd confirm with them first, then.
那你最好先跟他们确认一下。
M
I'll call them right now.
我现在就给他们打电话。
q: What will the man do next?
ex: 机票太贵、大巴太慢，他想改成视频报告，接下来先打电话跟客户确认。火车因罢工取消。

intro: Listen to the announcement at an airport. Why is the flight delayed?
lines: F
Attention, please. This is an announcement for passengers on Flight two-oh-six to Seattle.
请注意，这是给飞往西雅图的二零六号航班旅客的广播。
F
Your flight is delayed by forty minutes.
您的航班将延误四十分钟。
F
The weather in Seattle is fine, and the plane is already here.
西雅图天气良好，飞机也已经到达。
F
But the pilots are still on another flight that landed late.
但机长们还在另一架晚点降落的航班上。
F
The new boarding time is three twenty. Please wait near Gate eight.
新的登机时间是三点二十分，请在八号登机口附近等候。
F
Thank you for your patience.
感谢您的耐心等待。
q: Why is the flight delayed?
c: The weather in Seattle is bad
The plane has not arrived yet
ex: 广播说天气良好、飞机已到，延误是因为机长乘坐的另一航班晚点。登机口只是提醒在八号口等候。

intro: Listen to the conversation in an office. When is the team meeting today?
lines: M
Lisa, is the team meeting at ten today?
丽莎，今天团队会议是十点吗？
F
It usually is, but the boss has a doctor's appointment this morning.
平时是，但老板今天上午要去看医生。
M
So is it at eleven?
那是十一点？
F
No, she said one thirty, after lunch.
不，她说是午饭后一点半。
M
OK. I have a call at three, so that's fine.
好，我三点有个电话，那没问题。
F
Good. It's in the same room as always.
好，还是老会议室。
q: When is the team meeting today?
ex: 平时是十点，今天老板上午看医生，改到午饭后一点半。三点是男士自己的电话。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a hotel front desk. Why does the woman want to change rooms?
lines: F
Excuse me, can I change my room?
打扰一下，我能换个房间吗？
M
Of course. Is it too small?
当然可以。是房间太小吗？
F
No, the size is fine, and the view is nice.
不是，大小可以，景色也不错。
M
Is it noisy, then?
那是太吵？
F
Not really. But the shower doesn't have any hot water.
也不算。是淋浴没有热水。
M
I'm so sorry. Let me give you room three-oh-two.
非常抱歉，给您换到三零二号房。
q: Why does the woman want to change rooms?
ex: 她否定了房间小、太吵，还说景色不错，真正原因是淋浴没有热水。

intro: Listen to the weather report. What will the weather be like on Saturday?
lines: M
Here's the weather for the weekend.
下面是周末天气。
M
Friday will be cloudy, with some rain in the evening.
周五多云，傍晚有雨。
M
On Saturday, the rain will stop. It will be sunny, but very windy.
周六雨停，晴天，但风很大。
M
Sunday will be warm and sunny, a great day for a picnic.
周日温暖晴朗，很适合野餐。
M
Don't forget your umbrella on Friday night.
周五晚上别忘了带伞。
